nodes.label: Automatic Database Reset
nodes.rationale: Resets the database by dropping and recreating tables when no users exist, facilitating first-time setup and local development.

nodes.label: Standard Container Layout Pattern
nodes.rationale: Ensures responsive layout centering on mobile while left-aligning and padding settings pages on desktop to maintain design consistency.

nodes.label: Full-Height List Layout Pattern
nodes.rationale: Fills the viewport with a border-separated header and an independently scrollable list area, optimal for tabular/data types lists.

nodes.label: Label Propagation Algorithm (LPA)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for its simplicity, performance (O(V+E)), and scalability in discovering highly connected communities in large relationship graphs.

nodes.label: 3D Bounding Hulls
nodes.rationale: Visualizes crowd overlaps and community memberships by drawing semi-transparent bounding spheres or hulls around dynamic nodes in 3D space.

nodes.label: Empty States Patterns
nodes.rationale: Design philosophy emphasizes scanability and minimal friction; empty states encourage CTA buttons to initiate interactions directly.

nodes.label: External Tools Security Model
nodes.rationale: Restricts external network requests through SSRF filters, loopback prevention, and separate encrypted-at-rest secret tables to prevent data exfiltration.

nodes.label: Union-Centric Database Design
nodes.rationale: Abandons standard parent-child foreign keys in favor of a union hyperedge to natively support multiple partners, blended families, and pedigree collapse without data duplication.

nodes.label: Recursive CTE Graph Traversal
nodes.rationale: Offloads multi-generation traversal to the database level to avoid the N+1 query problem, while incorporating cycle detection to prevent infinite loops from pedigree collapse.

nodes.label: ELK.js Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: Utilizes Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK.js) to resolve coordinate placement for multi-marriage networks on same layers, which standard DAG libraries fail to align.

nodes.label: GDPR Living Person Privacy
nodes.rationale: Enforces an is_living flag to automatically obfuscate PII for living individuals in public shares, ensuring regulatory compliance under GDPR.

nodes.label: Short-lived Conversations Threading
nodes.rationale: Groups messages into short periods of communication (hours/days) rather than an entire timeline, maintaining lightweight and browsable records.

nodes.label: Three Classes of Data target model
nodes.rationale: Partitions tables into user-private, shared-by-default, and system-wide categories to isolate user workflows while allowing shared contact intelligence.
nodes.norm_label: three classes of data target model

nodes.label: Central Authorization Filters
nodes.rationale: Applies a SQL query filter to restrict row visibility based on ownership, preventing AI tool leaks and unauthenticated data exposure.

nodes.label: Collapsible Accordions for Profile Layout
nodes.rationale: Replaces Tabs with Accordions on PersonProfile pages, allowing users to fold/collapse sections dynamically for better space management.
